problem: The text says the autopilot and flight director 'fly the command'. The flight director does not move the controls; it only shows steering cues on the attitude display. A student may write in an exam that the flight director is an actuator.
fix: Say: the FMS computes the steering command. The autopilot flies it by moving the controls. The flight director only displays the steering cue for the pilot; when the autopilot is engaged it follows the same command. Neither unit makes the plan.

problem: The arithmetic is rounded inconsistently. Time is written as 1.333 h, but 2000 x 1.333 = 2666 kg, not 2666.7 kg. The value 2666.7 kg comes from 1.3333 h.
fix: Use one value throughout: time = 600 / 450 = 1.3333 h (1 h 20 min); fuel = 2000 kg/h x 1.3333 h = 2666.7 kg, about 2667 kg.
